create_CloudStorage: create a CloudStorage instance configured with S3 credentials from environment variables
upload_file_S3: upload a local file to an S3 bucket with auto-detected content type and return the object URL
upload_and_cleanup_S3: upload a local file to S3 and automatically delete the local copy after successful upload
test_is_enabled: test whether CloudStorage is enabled by checking S3 configuration and boto3 availability
create_cloud_storage_global: create the global cloud_storage singleton instance for use across the application
